name: edits in different paragraphs
intent: disjoint edits both apply
base:
Load-in is at 2pm.

Doors open at 8pm.
expect:
Load-in is at 1pm.

Doors open at 7:30pm.

name: edits to different words of one sentence
intent: disjoint edits inside one sentence both apply
base: The van leaves Leeds at nine with four people.
expect: The van leaves Manchester at nine with five people.

name: both insert at the same point
intent: both inserts kept, the earlier write first
expect: Setlist: Intro, Night Drive, Glass Hearts, Encore.

name: same typo fixed by both
intent: an identical change applies once
expect: The show starts at nine.

name: same sentence deleted by both
intent: a delete both made applies once and nothing else goes
base: Keep this. Remove this sentence. Keep that.
expect: Keep this. Keep that.

name: competing rewrites of one word
intent: two replacements of the same span: the later write wins
base: Meet at the stage door at six.
expect: Meet at the stage door at seven.

name: a typing burst while a bandmate edits elsewhere
intent: a chain of small own writes merges with a concurrent edit
expect: Notes: van booked for Friday morning. Hotel confirmed.

name: offline session against online edits
intent: a long offline chain merges with edits made meanwhile
expect:
# Rider (Leeds)

- still water
- 6 towels
- fruit
- hummus and bread

name: paragraph split while the second half is edited
intent: a split and an edit after it both apply
base: We drove to Leeds. The show was sold out and loud.
expect:
We drove to Leeds.

The show was completely sold out and loud.

name: paragraphs joined while one is edited
intent: a join and an edit inside both apply
base:
We drove to Leeds.

The show was sold out.
expect: We flew to Leeds. The show was sold out.

name: edit inside a paragraph someone deleted
intent: no lost work: an insert inside a deleted span survives
base:
Intro.

The Glasgow date is cancelled.

Outro.

intent: a cosmetic rewrite elsewhere keeps the real edit

Bring *two* spare strings.

Bring _two_ spare strings.

This is _really_ important, everyone.

intent: multi-unit characters merge without corruption

name: html: concurrent deletes leave well-formed markup

name: two people type in the same sentence, syncing often

ready. Keys are in the office.
